name: Kog'Maw
title: the Mouth of the Abyss

Q.name: Caustic Spittle
Q.description: Passive: Kog'Maw gains 5/10/15/20/25% Attack Speed. Active: Kog'Maw vomits a corrosive projectile that deals 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.9×AP magic damage to the first enemy hit and shreds 16/20/24/28/32% Armor and Magic Resist for 4 seconds.
Q.summary: Kog'Maw launches a corrosive projectile which deals magic damage and corrodes the target's armor and magic resist for a short time. Kog'Maw also gains additional attack speed.

W.name: Bio-Arcane Barrage
W.description: Kog'Maw gains 130/150/170/190/210 Attack Range and his Attacks deal an additional (3/3.75/4.5/5.25/6 + 0.015×AP) × 0.01 max Health magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit for 8 seconds.
W.summary: Kog'Maw's attacks gain range and deal a percent of the target's maximum health as magic damage %i:OnHit% On-Hit.

E.name: Void Ooze
E.description: Kog'Maw spits bile, dealing 70/110/150/190/230 + 0.65×AP magic damage and leaving a trail of ooze for 3 seconds. Enemies in the ooze are Slowed by 40/45/50/55/60%.
E.summary: Kog'Maw launches a peculiar ooze which damages all enemies it passes through and leaves a trail which slows enemies who stand on it.

R.name: Living Artillery
R.description: Kog'Maw shoots acid at an area, dealing 100/140/180 + 0.35/0.4/0.45×AP + 0.75×bonus AD plus 0.833% per 1% missing Health magic damage and revealing enemies hit for 2 seconds. Enemies below 40% Health instead take (100/140/180 + 0.35/0.4/0.45×AP + 0.75×bonus AD) × 2 magic damage. Subsequent shots within 8 seconds cost an additional 40 Mana (max: 400 Mana).
R.summary: Kog'Maw fires an artillery shell at a great distance dealing magic damage (increased significantly on low health enemies) and revealing non-stealthed targets. Additionally, multiple Living Artilleries in a short period of time cause them to cost additional Mana.

Passive.name: Icathian Surprise
Passive.description: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.
Passive.summary: 4 seconds after dying, Kogmaw explodes, dealing true damage to surrounding enemies.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Immobile hypercarry whose W turns his attacks into long-range percent-health damage. Weak and passive early, he melts anyone late if his team peels for him.
strengths: Huge late-game damage during W, including %max HP that shreds tanks
Very long range while W is up
R artillery pokes and finishes from far away
Q shreds armor and MR for his team
Excellent with peel supports (Lulu, Janna, Braum)
weaknesses: No dash or escape at all
Weak early: low damage before attack speed items
Totally dependent on peel; easy dive target
R costs more mana each time it's used in a row

curve.lvl1: weak – no W range, low damage
curve.items: strong – attack speed + on-hit (Guinsoo's, Blade of the Ruined King)

profile.curveNote: Mostly farms; trades only during W windows with support help.
profile.waveClear: medium – W attacks and Q; R costly
profile.mobility: none – E slow is his only escape tool

Q.notes: Shreds armor and MR on hit.

W.notes: Bonus range and %max HP magic on-hit for a few seconds: his whole damage window.

E.notes: Ooze line slows; his only peel.

R.notes: Delayed artillery; mana cost stacks with repeated casts.

Passive.notes: Explodes after death, dealing true damage.

profile.windowAgainst: W on cooldown: he has short range and little damage; dive him. Levels 1–5 before items.
